question: The amount on a sum of ₹2,000 at 5% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, in 2 years will be:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective rate of compound interest for 2 years at 5% = 5 + 5 + (5 × 5)/100 = 10.25%

Total amount percentage after 2 years = 100% (Principal) + 10.25% (Interest) = 110.25%

Amount = 110.25% of 2000

Amount = 1.1025 × 2000 = 2205

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2205.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2000

Rate of Interest (R) = 5% per annum

Time Period (n) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount (A) = P × (1 + R/100)ⁿ
